g.text: Testing the size of the gulf

g.text: Three cuts into the same coastal sector, shown at the same scale in a local equal-area projection.

text.style: font-size: 12px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #243c43

g.text: Moderate is the comparison specimen. Visual review finds limited continental-scale benefit; adoption is deferred.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #536a6e

g.text: Marine intrusion requires sustained basin accommodation. Sediment supply and subsidence may instead fill or restrict the gulf.
